# THRYLOS INDIA — full reference

> THRYLOS INDIA is a technology studio based in New Delhi, India that designs, builds, launches and supports websites, web apps, mobile apps, cloud systems, AI integrations and cybersecurity for startups and businesses.

## Business facts
- Legal name: THRYLOS INDIA
- Registered address: New Delhi, India
- Website: https://thrylosindia.in
- Email: support@thrylosindia.in, founder@thrylosindia.in
- Founder & Grievance Officer: Utsav Ratan
- Serves: clients across India and worldwide, remotely

## Services
- Website development: business sites, landing pages, e-commerce, CMS and blogs.
- Web applications: dashboards, portals, SaaS products, booking and payment systems.
- Mobile apps: Android and iOS apps (cross-platform).
- Cloud & DevOps: hosting, deployment, scaling, backups and monitoring.
- AI integration: chatbots, automation, content and data tools built into products.
- Cybersecurity: security reviews, hardening, authentication and MFA, data protection.
- Digital strategy: product planning, UX/UI design, SEO and growth.

## How working with THRYLOS INDIA works
1. Get started: describe your project at https://thrylosindia.in/get-started.
2. Choose a project manager at https://thrylosindia.in/choose-manager.
3. Agree scope, milestones and budget; pay securely via Cashfree (UPI, cards, net banking).
4. Track progress, milestones and invoices in your dashboard.
5. Launch, then ongoing support.

## Trust & verification
- Every invoice, HR document and employee ID card carries a QR/barcode verifiable at https://thrylosindia.in/verify.
- Coordinator accounts use Google Authenticator two-step verification.
- Personal data handled under India's DPDP Act, 2023; see https://thrylosindia.in/privacy-policy.

## Frequently asked
- Q: Where is THRYLOS INDIA located? A: New Delhi, India; it works with clients remotely worldwide.
- Q: How do I start? A: Use the Get Started form or email support@thrylosindia.in.
- Q: How are payments made? A: Through Cashfree Payments, milestone by milestone, with a GST-ready invoice each time.
- Q: What is the refund policy? A: See https://thrylosindia.in/refund-policy.
- Q: Can I verify a THRYLOS document? A: Yes, scan its QR code or enter its ID at https://thrylosindia.in/verify.
